Loading: production build and eight cold/warm cohorts; actual JavaScript bytes reduced; architecture, surface preservation and motif units pass. Full type gate remains for integration.
Final integration: full app, tools, tests, Svelte and domains type checks; zero errors and zero Svelte warnings.
All six native/material/native continuity and lifecycle tests pass across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit; final fractional smoke also passes all 41 samples.

Six pass, three pre-existing failures. Isolated pre-change baseline at 53f579ec5 reproduces identical 1.21 typography ratio, 5.0625px inverse-center spread and missing editor home link. No thresholds weakened; see delivery evidence.
Final integration: all architecture and budget checks pass; no ceilings increased.
All 11 preservation tests pass; shared glyph compositor, runtime-hardening and new sparse-focus units also pass.
Exact final source: 41 samples, no failures. Desktop/phone rising prose, find, Read all, font reflow, controls and print/static preservation also pass.

Eight fresh production cohorts after final build: local scripting reductions 8 to 25 percent, layouts 14 to 17 percent, gzip JS 5.7 percent. Variable readiness and remaining slow-CPU stalls recorded honestly.
Final diagnostic: 196 applies instead of 332; 53 genuine preparations retained; unchanged idle and prose measurement counts; direct jumps do not replay and four cold URLs prepare only once.

allowedWork: Measured performance repairs in reader loading, preparation, sampling and lifecycle; bounded investigations and verification
